name: aramayo-content-platform
description: Plataforma de contenido y publicación de Ferretería y Lubricentro Aramayo.

scripts.brief:eval: pnpm --filter @aramayo/configuration build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/domain build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/database build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/worker eval:brief
scripts.brief:smoke: pnpm --filter @aramayo/configuration build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/domain build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/database build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/worker smoke:brief
scripts.commercial:smoke: pnpm --filter @aramayo/configuration build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/domain build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/database build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/worker smoke:commercial
scripts.composition:snapshot: pnpm --filter @aramayo/domain build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/design-engine build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/worker review:composition
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: node tools/run-with-env.mjs pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate:dev: node tools/run-with-env.mjs pnpm exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: pnpm --filter @aramayo/database build && node tools/run-with-env.mjs pnpm exec prisma db seed
scripts.db:test: pnpm --filter @aramayo/domain build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/database build && node tools/run-with-env.mjs node infrastructure/database/dist/verify.js
scripts.e2e:publishing: pnpm --filter @aramayo/domain build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/database build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/api build && node tools/run-with-env.mjs node tools/e2e-publishing/cli.ts
scripts.image:smoke: pnpm --filter @aramayo/configuration build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/domain build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/worker smoke:image
scripts.image-quality:eval: pnpm --filter @aramayo/domain build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/design-engine build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/worker eval:image-quality
scripts.knowledge:smoke: pnpm --filter @aramayo/configuration build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/domain build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/database build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/worker smoke:knowledge
scripts.media:smoke:cloudinary: pnpm --filter @aramayo/configuration build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/design-engine build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/worker smoke:cloudinary
scripts.openai:smoke: pnpm --filter @aramayo/configuration build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/domain build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/worker smoke:openai
scripts.publish:smoke: pnpm --filter @aramayo/configuration build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/domain build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/database build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/worker smoke:publish
scripts.test: pnpm --recursive test && pnpm run infra:test && pnpm run production:test && node --test tools/smoke/*.test.ts tools/design-baseline/*.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --recursive typecheck && pnpm run infra:typecheck && pnpm run production:typecheck && pnpm run smoke:typecheck && pnpm run baseline:typecheck && pnpm run design:typecheck && pnpm run e2e:typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm run verify:stack && pnpm run verify:plan && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run build && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run baseline:verify && pnpm run smoke
scripts.visual:snapshot: pnpm --filter @aramayo/domain build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/design-engine build && pnpm --filter @aramayo/worker snapshot:visual
